commander.title: Commander
commander.description: Commanders are driven to achieve goals through determination and holding themselves and others to high standards of performance.

shaper.title: Shaper
shaper.description: Shapers visualize ambitious goals, set plans in place, and push through relentlessly to make them happen.

quietLeader.title: Quiet Leader
quietLeader.description: Quiet Leaders focus on leading themselves and others through their open-mindedness and their equanimity in facing challenges - often leading as much through 'taking in' as 'putting out'.

inspirer.title: Inspirer
inspirer.description: Inspirers lead through motivating people to get behind a challenging and important idea, project, or business objective.

campaigner.title: Campaigner
campaigner.description: Campaigners focus on rallying others around ideas, positions, and solutions and achieving practical results.

coach.title: Coach
coach.description: Coaches regard self-growth, development, and learning as a cornerstone of life and daily practices and they teach and model these as aspirations for others.

promoter.title: Promoter
promoter.description: Promoters are distinguished by their outgoing and charismatic nature and people skills.

impresario.title: Impresario
impresario.description: Impresarios love to entertain, engage socially, and facilitate great experiences with others.

entertainer.title: Entertainer
entertainer.description: Entertainers are driven by creating experiences and engaging with the world and particularly the people in it.

peacekeeper.title: Peacekeeper
peacekeeper.description: Peacekeepers relish developing positive relationships between people, and seeking harmony, compromise, and cooperation.

problemSolver.title: Problem Solver
problemSolver.description: Problem Solvers are motivated to support and help others in an industrious and professional manner.

helper.title: Helper
helper.description: Helpers are driven by compassion and care for others, and support of their emotional needs.

strategist.title: Strategist
strategist.description: Strategists are adept at generating and translating concepts and ideas into effective strategies to achieve results.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: Planners are driven to put structure and systems around goals, translating ideas into practical and achievable plans.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Orchestrators excel at bringing people together, organizing around them, and mobilizing resources to achieve and exceed expectations.

implementer.title: Implementer
implementer.description: Implementers organize and structure people and processes to reliably execute tasks.

investigator.title: Investigator
investigator.description: Investigators like to research and analyze information and data to build knowledge and understanding.

technician.title: Technician
technician.description: Technicians are driven to break down, analyze, and solve problems in a technical and practical way.

adventurer.title: Adventurer
adventurer.description: Adventurers are motivated by taking part in fun, exciting, and adventurous activities and pursuits.

artisan.title: Artisan
artisan.description: Artisans are driven to use their creativity to bring life to beautiful and well-crafted ideas.

inventor.title: Inventor
inventor.description: Inventors are driven by coming up with new and innovative ideas, products, and solutions.

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.description: Explorers love to take in new knowledge and are drawn to new experiences through intrinsic motivations.

thinker.title: Thinker
thinker.description: Thinkers are inclined to approach problems in an abstract, philosophical fashion. They naturally seek the deeper meaning of issues that arise in their daily lives.

growthSeeker.title: Growth Seeker
growthSeeker.description: Growth Seekers are defined by a deep passion for learning and personal growth and development.

protector.title: Protector
protector.description: Protectors care about traditions, rules, and standards, and are driven by a strong sense of personal duty.

enforcer.title: Enforcer
enforcer.description: Enforcers are driven to engage with the world through reliance on standards, rules, and traditions.

critic.title: Critic
critic.description: Critics freely express their opinions and love debating different perspectives with others.

individualist.title: Individualist
individualist.description: Individualists walk to the beat of their own drum and find unique ways of expressing themselves and their originality.
